Untrust removes a peer's bundle (bus/peers/<host>.json) and its ssh
destination (agent bus ssh), then restarts the bus so the peer is dropped
at once (--no-restart leaves that to agent bus restart). Friction links
and agents' spawned_by that name it stay, as history.

Untrusting on one side is enough to cut the link: the hub refuses a peer
it doesn't pin, and a leaf no longer dials a hub it doesn't trust. The
other side keeps listing this host until it untrusts it too.

Usage:
  agent bus untrust <host> [flags]

Examples:
  agent bus untrust old-laptop
  agent bus untrust hub --no-restart

Flags:
  -h, --help         help for untrust
      --no-restart   Don't restart the bus; agent bus restart applies the change

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
